name: Enterprise Analytical Study, Finding and Recommendation Binding
constraints: WM-ACT-036 owns analytical-study identity, question, protocol, population, sampling, method application, estimates and limitations.
WM-ACT-034 contributes assessment mechanics through a non-mastership relation; it is neither a specialization parent nor an identity source for Analytical Study.

Every WM-KNW-007 claim in this profile carries independent closed discriminators claimMood and claimKind. Finding means claimMood=assertoric; Recommendation means claimMood=deontic. This profile creates no Recommendation type or identifier.

claimKind is descriptive, associational or causal. A causal claim is admissible only when measurand, comparator, design, competing-explanation analysis and sampling-frame-bias discharge are all recorded.
A finding claimKind must be permitted by the pinned Analysis Method revision and must independently satisfy the study-level claim gate; neither condition alone is sufficient.
Every finding specification pins study, method revision, sample version and data version; unresolved identities make the pin pending rather than empty or defaulted.

Every method deviation is classified within-applicability or out-of-applicability. An out-of-applicability deviation retains the pin but removes method warrant for affected causal outputs, which become associational or withdrawn.

Competing interpretations remain conflict-linked claims. Ranking, preference or confidence never eliminates a rival. An explicit WM-KNW-007 defeater claim with its own mood, kind and pins marks a rival defeated and retained.
A recommendation's deontic mood confers no authority, permission, competence, disposition or effect. WM-KNW-010 owns decision rationale and WM-ACT-024 owns the authorized occurrence.
A recommendation may have zero or more decisions; decision content may exist without an antecedent recommendation. Rejection leaves the recommendation unchanged and resolvable.
A WM-REC-002 report pins the exact study and finding versions it renders and introduces no conclusion absent from those findings.
Changing any finding pin creates a retained superseding successor; the predecessor and reports pinned to it remain immutable.
outOfScope: allocation of Analysis Method, sample or dataset identity
holds: Sample and dataset identity have no allocated basis in this profile, so the four-part finding pin is specified but not executable.
Conflict-link, defeater, successor and assessment-mechanics relation contracts remain unregistered.
Recommendation is only a mood-discriminated WM-KNW-007 claim here; any future Recommendation specialization requires separate allocation and audit.
WM-REC-002 and the other bases are not canonically publishable.
Source/profile pins and crosswalks remain incomplete.
All fixtures are specified but not executed.
